bullets.text: Ten people were killed in a Russian attack on a drone exhibition near Kyiv, with ballistic missiles hitting the event attended by Ukrainian defence industry members.
Israeli settlers reportedly set fire to mosques, cars, and farmland in the West Bank, following a clash that resulted in the deaths of four Palestinians and two Israelis.
Firefighters are battling wildfires near Bordeaux, France, with over 330,000 people evacuated from blazes across France and Spain.
Secret reports have revealed that tunnel workers on major Australian infrastructure projects were repeatedly exposed to silica dust levels far beyond workplace standards.
Hobart's deputy lord mayor has apologised for taking snacks and drinks from a council lounge over several years, an issue that continues to be a point of contention among councillors.
A nationwide test of the new AusAlert emergency system is scheduled for this afternoon, with a loud siren expected to sound on phones across Australia.

Bond traders anticipate a potential Federal Reserve interest rate hike this week, with risks mounting due to flaring Middle East tensions that have driven up oil prices and boosted inflation concerns.
China is increasing its funding for green energy deals through its Belt and Road Initiative, capitalizing on the rising demand for renewables as the Middle East conflict impacts oil demand.
Australia's Prime Minister Anthony Albanese plans to directly address former President Donald Trump regarding new tariffs announced by Washington, which Albanese describes as unjustified.
